title: Development of Multi-arm 3D Printing System with Integrated Horizontal and Vertical Reinforcement
fundingAgency: Karunya Short-Term Research Grant (KSRG) — Seed Money
description: Concrete 3D printing can place material accurately, but reinforcement still largely has to be added by hand, which removes much of the advantage automation offers. This project develops a multi-arm printing system in which horizontal and vertical reinforcement is integrated during deposition rather than afterwards.

title: APT – M: Additive Printing Technology for Masonry
fundingAgency: Tamil Nadu State Council for Science and Technology (TNSCST)
description: A proposal to extend additive printing methods to masonry construction, bringing together the masonry strengthening work of the doctoral research and the printing work that followed it.
